title: Android 3.3.0 and upwards, huge increase in battery drain
symptom: After upgrading from AAPS 3.2.0.4 to 3.3.1.2, battery drain increased from about 5% per day to about 20% per day. Fresh install, clearing cache, and disabling NSClientV3 did not help. Reinstalling 3.2.0.4 reduces drain back to 5%.
evidence_quote: Clearing logs and resetting to default hasn't worked unfortunately.
